title: Sparkly magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Wand stick -->
  <rect x="42" y="30" width="6" height="55" rx="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- Wand stick highlight -->
  <rect x="43" y="30" width="2" height="55" rx="1" fill="#C89050"/>
  <!-- Wand tip / star holder -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="30" r="7" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="30" r="5" fill="#FFF4A3"/>
  <!-- Star on top -->
  <polygon points="45,8 48,20 60,20 50,27 54,39 45,32 36,39 40,27 30,20 42,20" fill="#FFE44D" stroke="#FFF9B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Star center glow -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="24" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top right -->
  <g transform="translate(72,15)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-8" x2="0" y2="8" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-8" y1="0" x2="8" y2="0" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="-5" x2="5" y2="5" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="5" y1="-5" x2="-5" y2="5" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - left -->
  <g transform="translate(15,45)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-6" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="0" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="-4" x2="4" y2="4" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="-4" x2="-4" y2="4" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - bottom right -->
  <g transform="translate(75,65)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-7" x2="0" y2="7" stroke="#B388FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-7" y1="0" x2="7" y2="0" stroke="#B388FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="-5" x2="5" y2="5" stroke="#B388FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="5" y1="-5" x2="-5" y2="5" stroke="#B388FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - small top left -->
  <g transform="translate(22,18)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#7DF9FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - small bottom left -->
  <g transform="translate(20,78)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 6 - small right middle -->
  <g transform="translate(80,42)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="12" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="50" r="2" fill="#7DF9FF"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#B388FF"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="82" r="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#FF6EC7"/>
  
  <!-- Tiny sparkle trails -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#7DF9FF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
